d: The Houthis have escalated tensions in West Asia by claiming attacks on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery and a military radar facility. As Saudi Arabia faces a growing threat from Iran-backed Houthi forces, its oil infrastructure, military defences and regional influence are increasingly under pressure. But this is bigger than a Saudi-Yemen conflict. With tensions involving the US, Israel and Iran disrupting global energy routes, the Houthis are emerging as a major threat to Red Sea shipping and Gulf security.
